channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Iran sets conditions for opening Strait of Hormuz after UAE says one of its ships was targeted by airstrike
item.description: Iran's military stressed that the crucial waterway would only be reopened when the U.S. accepts Iran's conditions.

item.title: Myspace eyes comeback as an an 'antidote' to social media fatigue — but it may be a long shot
item.description: "Excitement about Myspace's relaunch reflects nostalgia for a more analog time, when algorithms were less dominant in our lives," an analyst told CNBC.

item.title: Berkshire earnings rose last quarter and CEO Greg Abel is starting to deploy Buffett's massive cash hoard
item.description: Strength across its energy, railroad and manufacturing businesses more than offset weaker insurance results.

item.title: Hugging Face hack marks start of dangerous AI cyber era and many firms 'don't even know it'
item.description: The Black Hat cybersecurity conference in Las Vegas couldn't have come at a better time, with AI agent hacks stacking up from Anthropic, Meta and OpenAI.

item.title: Canada's British Columbia declares state of emergency as more than 20,000 flee wildfires
item.description: Officials say the Bald Range wildfire triggered the largest evacuation event so far this summer.

item.title: AI and job losses: How the next automation wave will impact the workforce
item.description: Recent tech layoffs have raised alarms for workers. But multiple studies find that the wave driven by AI looks very different from past automation cycles.

item.title: Senate Republicans narrowly confirm Todd Blanche as attorney general
item.description: Blanche won confirmation in a 50-49 vote, with Republican Senators Susan Collins and Lisa Murkowski opposing him. Senator Bill Cassidy was the deciding vote.

item.title: Verizon mobile service restored after outage for thousands of customers in the U.S.
item.description: Customers still having trouble with their service should restart their devices, the wireless carrier said. Verizon did not provide ⁠a reason for ⁠the outage.

item.title: Hunter Biden says Joe Biden’s cancer has spread further and is ‘very painful’
item.description: "The cancer has spread, is metastasized into his bones and further. It's very painful. It's very debilitating in many respects," Hunter Biden said.

item.title: Cyclospora fears lead consumers to lose their appetite for salads
item.description: Traffic to salad chains has fallen as consumers avoid greens due to the ongoing cyclospora outbreaks across the U.S.

item.title: 'Moneymaxxing' isn't a trend, it's a 'cultural shift,' financial advisor says — here's how to get started
item.description: In an affordability crunch, social media's viral "maxxing" trend could lead to long-term financial security.

item.title: For retirees, staying in the stock market is critical. How much exposure is the make-or-break question
item.description: Investors should be conversative in retirement, but abandoning equities is a big mistake.

item.title: ICE says it expects to equip every field officer with body cameras by the end of August
item.description: ICE defended its policy amid questions about provisions allowing it to withhold or indefinitely delay footage after serious injuries or deaths in custody.

item.title: Formula One is lagging other sport stocks. Why analysts think it's poised to race ahead
item.description: As the sports sector remains resilient among consumers, analysts are predicting big gains for this racing league.

item.title: S&P 500 rises to record close Friday and posts strongest week since April: Live updates
item.description: The three major averages posted their best weekly performances since April.

item.title: Next big push in ETF industry? Why these risk assets are gaining traction as interest rate uncertainty persists
item.description: Collateralized loan obligations may become the next big push in the exchange-traded fund industry.

item.title: Inside the startup drone maker powering Ukraine's deep-strike campaign
item.description: Fire Point CEO Iryna Terekh says Ukraine has "learned the hard way" that military leverage is integral to to bringing diplomacy within reach.

item.title: Elevator giant Otis wants to be a defensive play in a volatile market. It has to prove itself first
item.description: Otis positions itself as a long-term growth stock, but shares are down due to setbacks in its elevator service business and investors chasing the AI trade.

item.title: Companies scoff at airlines' cheapest business class tickets. 'The real value is flexibility'
item.description: Some companies plan to shun the cheapest business- and premium- economy fares from their executives.

item.title: How cleaning up space debris could grow to become a big business
item.description: As Earth’s orbit gets more crowded, companies are betting that cleaning up space junk could become a lucrative new business.

item.description: AI stocks roared back to help lift two of the major averages to fresh records.

item.description: Grow your savings in just 12 months with these top CDs.

item.title: Burger King overtakes Wendy's as the nation's second-largest burger chain
item.description: Burger King is once again the second-largest burger chain in the U.S. by system-wide sales.

item.title: Democrats plan Trump investigations over impeachment if they win House, sources say
item.description: Senior Democrats have discussed using hearings, subpoenas and document requests to obtain records from entities tied to Trump's orbit, the sources said.

item.title: Hollywood is cranking out billion-dollar movies again. 'Spider-Man' just joined the ranks
item.description: Box office analysts say the resurgence of billion-dollar releases bodes well for a film industry that's still chasing pre-Covid levels, even with higher prices.

item.title: Prediction markets take center stage in latest round of quarterly earnings reports
item.description: Recent quarterly reports from DraftKings, Flutter Entertainment and others offer a view into prediction markets businesses and their performance.

item.title: ‘SaaSpocalypse’ debate intensifies as software stocks swing wildly
item.description: This week saw massive moves in both directions for software stocks, as investors try to figure out which names are best insulated from artificial intelligence.

item.title: A record-breaking week for options powers S&P 500 surge; volatility gauge is near 2026 low
item.description: The broad market benchmark soared to records this week, benefiting from options activity and a calmer VIX.

item.title: U.S. Senate passes short-term funding bill to avert federal shutdown before election

item.description: Nonfarm payrolls in the U.S. unexpectedly declined in July, but so did the unemployment rate, leaving investors with mixed signals.
